name: picmovi-agent-tools
description: PicMovi photo to video agent tools: REST client, CLI, and stdio MCP adapter.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @picmovi/agent-core && npm run build -w @picmovi/client && npm run build -w picmovi-mcp && npm run build -w picmovi-cli
scripts.mcp: npm run build -w @picmovi/agent-core && npm run build -w @picmovi/client && npm run build -w picmovi-mcp && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js
